cls: Would PGO or some always inline annotations with moving the functions to cc files help here? I wonder if you actually need it inlined in official builds that run all optimizations.
What has been really useful for profiling (filtering) is prefixes to the functions to see what time we actually spend in the copy. E.g., `SimdCopyChars()`.
